controller_owned_xdist_publication.rule: Workers may read immutable candidates and return bounded public intents. They never publish receipt or locator state. Missing coordination disables skips and writes; ordinary pytest execution remains available.

locator_first_seed.rule: Collection attaches a stable locator without fixture setup, test call, final execution key, eligibility, cache hit, or skip authority.

runtime_trace.rule: Observation is a side channel around one ordinary pytest protocol execution. Incomplete or historical traces retain no publication authority.

inventory.gap: exact fixture-instance key becomes safely authoritative only after current setup; add pre-call V2 key and honest composite phase receipt

gap_detail.authoritative_execution_key_before_setup: AutomaticItemIdentityAssembler cannot normally construct an authoritative TestExecutionKey@1 before setup because fixture values do not exist and RuntimeTestDependencyTrace@1 is produced during execution. Absent CurrentRuntimeTraceEvidence@1 from a fresh controlled preflight, assembly returns typed non-reusable RUN.
gap_detail.composite_phase_receipt: ProofReuseReceiptCapture@1 emits TestPassReceipt@1 only after a full three-phase pass. No CompositePhaseReceipt contract exists.
gap_detail.fixture_instance: TestIdentityComponents@1 / pytest-fixture@1 bind fixture definition, scope, dependencies, and an optional value/adapter CID. A definition without a reviewed value is uncontrolled_fixture_value and non-reusable. No fixture-instance commitment after current setup exists.
gap_detail.pre_call_v2_key: TestExecutionKey@1 is the current execution-key contract. TestExecutionKeyV2 is absent. TwoStageCandidateLookup@2 and ControllerOwnedV2VerificationContext@1 are lookup/publication V2 surfaces, not TestExecutionKeyV2.

limitations: TestExecutionKeyV2 is absent; current keys are TestExecutionKey@1.
Fixture-instance identity after current setup is not a contract; uncontrolled or unsupported fixture values force full execution.
Composite phase receipts are absent; only complete three-phase TestPassReceipt@1 exists.
Collection-time identity and locator-first seeds never authorize SKIP.
Current-context rebuild does not execute fixtures and cannot mint a post-setup fixture-instance key.
Signed runner attestations establish issuer assertion under explicit policy, not independent faithful execution.
Production ZK/key ceremony remains typed unavailable; groth16 binary presence is unqualified and not production-admitted.
Direct CPython execution proof is research-only and not production-admitted.
Simulated or structural proof cannot be admitted as production.
Unknown dependency completeness or opaque fixture adapters force full fallback.
ipfs_datasets_py.pytest_proof_reuse is not present in this tree; kit only re-exports the accelerate plugin.

Authoritative cache hits currently attach pytest.mark.skip with prefix proof-cache-hit:; successor workstreams require not labeling proof reuse as pytest skip. This records current behavior and does not change claim meaning.
Ordinary warm skip completeness remains gated on live runtime activation, exact CID-profile conformance, and admitted certificates; this inventory does not claim that path is complete.
Board validation phrases are descriptive intent. Executable commands in validation.commands are the sealed-PATH mapping of that intent and do not change claim meaning.
